name: The Fork
install:
python3.11 -m venv .venv
.venv/bin/pip install -U pip
.venv/bin/pip install -r requirements.txt
npm --prefix frontend ci

terminals.name: uvicorn
terminals.command: CEREBRUM_VIRGIN=false CEREBRUM_DOMAIN_KITS=construction ENV=development DATA_DIR="$PWD/data" PYTHONIOENCODING=utf-8 .venv/bin/python -m uvicorn app.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000 --reload
terminals.description: FastAPI backend + SPA on :8000 (SQLite). Build frontend/dist first for the real UI.
